Your Anki progress can't come across as due dates or intervals, because the import format has no fields for them. I mapped each card's interval to a status instead.

```csv
word,translation,example,lang,to,note,translation_note,picture,stickers,status
el perro,the dog,El perro duerme en el jardín.,es,en,,,,Animals,known
la ventana,the window,"Abre la ventana, por favor.",es,en,,,,House,learning
aprovechar,"to take advantage of, make the most of",Hay que aprovechar el buen tiempo.,es,en,,,,Verbs,learning
el cajón,drawer,Guardo las llaves en el cajón.,es,en,,,"a drawer in furniture, not a box",House,new
sin embargo,however,"Llovía; sin embargo, salimos a caminar.",es,en,,,,Connectors,known
la cuenta,the bill / the account,"¿Me trae la cuenta, por favor?",es,en,,also: a bank account,"a restaurant bill, not a bank account",Restaurant,learning
```

Copy the block, then in the app open Words → Add → Import from anything and paste it.
